honest_fail_notes.C3_cylinder_sigma_vs_jf_L2: Junger & Feit infinite-cylinder closure vs the finite capped cylinder exterior solve at R=0.5 m, L=2 m: max |gap| 41.1 % over ka in [0.5, 3]; the gap decays monotonically with ka (<= 6.1 % for ka >= 2.5) and is dominated by the axially antisymmetric m=2 modes in the compact regime, where an infinite-cylinder closure cannot be a valid reference.
honest_fail_notes.C4_cylinder_sigma_vs_jf_L8: same comparison at the length-converged L = 8 m: 30.3 % worst case, driven by the m=2 modes at ka <= 1; the low orders (1,0) and (1,1) are within 10.6 % over the whole band.

limitations: air, not water: fluid loading on the structure is neglected (added-mass frequency shift ~0.8 % here)

the cylinder radiation operator is verified on prescribed modal velocity fields; the shell eigenvalue problem of the repository's cylindrical Shell4 element is NOT verified (mesh sequence and Donnell low-n branch both unresolved)
the exterior solve is discretisation-limited to ~2 % (measured)
